hypothesis.name: Kneser K(n,k) (to be confirmed by binomial_match)
evidence: spectrum_integral true with 5 distinct eigenvalues (126, 21, 1, -6, -56), consistent with a Kneser graph having k+1 = 5 eigenvalues
board lower = 220 from an independent set, upper = 260 by clique_cover

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 220. Lower bound is an independent set of size 220 (check passed). Upper bound is a linear code M = I + 4A over F_5 whose length meets 220; code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed. The rank is consistent with the spectrum: 1 - theta vanishes mod 5 for theta = 126, 21, 1, leaving multiplicities 208 + 12 = 220. Accuracy: matches cpsat_alpha (220, proven, 12.2 s) and kushagra_agent (220/220 exact, F_5). It beats cpsat_cover (604, unproven), frac_cover (635.0, unproven) and f2_minrank_sat (no value). Time: compute was only 0.157 s, but wall time was 41.595 s, almost all LLM time (41.438 s). That loses clearly to kushagra_agent's 0.279 s and to cpsat_alpha's 12.2 s for the lower bound. Nothing suspicious; own_rank requested as an independent confirmation.
